trailofbits-php2shell-exploits-confirmed.name: Trail of Bits
trailofbits-php2shell-exploits-confirmed.text:
Our demo shows PHP2Shell giving a shell on MediaWiki, Symfony, Laravel, and phpBB.

We’ve confirmed exploits work on pre-patch releases of PHP 8.2–8.5. If you haven’t updated, assume attackers can compromise your server, and that exploitation will only get easier.

quoted.name: Dan Guido
quoted.text:
Update: Our PHP exploit is now production-grade.
* stock php.ini-production, display_errors=off, normal memory_limit, multi-worker, ASLR, under load
* ARM64 + x86-64 targets
* MediaWiki, WordPress, phpBB, Laravel
* Apache/mod_php and nginx/php-fpm -> root

chriscroy-chatgpt-seizure-nyt.name: Chris Croy
chriscroy-chatgpt-seizure-nyt.text:
The NY Times has a long read about a woman who suffered a fatal seizure after asking ChatGPT for advice on tapering off of her epilepsy meds.

"There’s no need to worry too much about your health", said the bot.

I instantly clocked exactly which model she was talking to.
